title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Quiet tape, energy bled, breadth ugly.
Semis held the tape up while 339 of 501 S&P names fell and 90 hit new 60-day lows — a narrow, defensive session with crude down 3.5% dragging the whole energy complex. QQQ put-call at 2.04 says someone is paying up for protection into the Oct 28 FOMC, and the dollar bid plus gold down 0.61% says it isn't a debasement trade.

INDICES — VIX 17.7, above its 15.8 20-day MA.
SOXX +0.64%, QQQ +0.03%, IWM -0.43%, SPY -0.44%, DIA -1.15%. Large > small by 0.45pp. Biggest cross-asset move: USO -3.52%, its first real crack after +19.52% on 20d. SPY sits below its 200-DMA with breadth at 49%, a live CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.5x on a -0.44% close: distribution, not accumulation. QQQ 1.1x on +0.03% — dead volume, no conviction either way. IJR 1.9x and DIA 1.8x both losing is downside participation. Breadth: only 31% above the 50-DMA, up/down volume 0.57, 8 highs vs 90 lows — participation diverges hard from the index; this is a narrow tape masking broad damage.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +0.10%, XLV Healthcare +0.07%, XLU Utilities +0.00%, XLI Industrials -0.08%, XLP Staples -0.48%, XLRE Real Estate -0.60%, XLY Discretionary -0.63%, XLB Materials -0.73%, XLC Comms -0.90%, XLF Financials -1.62%, XLE Energy -2.88%. Top industries: WGMI +3.46%, SMH +0.64%; bottom: FCG -5.63%, XOP -3.96%. Flows contradict price hard — XLF took +$670mm (79th pctile) while closing worst-but-one, and XLK bled -$542mm (6th pctile) while leading; that is short-covering and dip-buying, not conviction. Money is leaving energy (XOP -3.96%, FCG -5.63%) and heading to semis plus miners. Narrow mega-cap tape.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.82 neutral, but QQQ 2.04 is heavy protection demand. Skew +9.4% SPY / +10.7% QQQ — put premium bid. VIXEQ 36.5 vs VIX 17.7 is a wide gap: high single-stock dispersion, low implied correlation, a rotation tape, not a macro one. IWM GEX flip 279 vs max pain 280 — pin risk into expiry.

CROSS-ASSET — Crude -3.52% is the transmission chain: FANG -8.03%, COP -6.15%, FCG -5.63% all follow. Dollar +0.64% is pressuring gold -0.61% and silver -0.83%. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 52% no change, 46% for a 25bp hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 44.8, Neutral.
JBHT -13.30% on its own Q3 warning; FANG -8.03% on 7.9x volume, pure distribution. 20d momentum: XLC +2.28% best sector, XLI -8.10% worst; VLUE and SIZE carry bull regimes, IWF is 260 days bear. Watch XLF for the flow/price divergence, SOXX with $711mm inflows (92nd pctile), and IWM pinned near its 279 gamma flip.
